"""Three existing real installed-browser flows with private fixture authority."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT=Path('/private/tmp/hol-guard-cigar-control-preflight-20261025')
REPO=Path('/Users/construct/Documents/projects/cigar-project/CIGAR/hol-guard-cigar-integration')
INSTALLED=ROOT/'package/installed'
RUNTIME=INSTALLED/'codex_plugin_scanner/_native/hol-guard-runtime'
artifact=json.loads((ROOT/'package/installed-artifact-verification.json').read_text())
assert artifact['build_sha']=='1e341429b8006beec74c31cf8c0d230793c0be7f'
assert hashlib.sha256(RUNTIME.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==artifact['artifact_sha256']
job=ROOT/'browser-stop-diagnostic/acceptance'
job.mkdir(mode=0o700)
(job/'profile').mkdir(mode=0o700)
sys.path.insert(0,str(REPO))
from scripts.bench_guard_cigar_cohort import fingerprints
from scripts.cigar_benchmark_processes import ProcessSampler
selection=Path('/private/tmp/hol-guard-cigar-runtime-validation/selection.json')
approval=Path('/private/tmp/hol-guard-cigar-runtime-validation/approval.json')
os.environ['GUARD_CIGAR_TEST_SELECTION']=str(selection)
os.environ['GUARD_CIGAR_TEST_APPROVAL']=str(approval)
selected_python=Path(json.loads(selection.read_text())['python'])
node=Path('/usr/local/bin/node')
modules=REPO/'dashboard/node_modules'
cli=modules/'@playwright/test/cli.js'
assert json.loads((modules/'@playwright/test/package.json').read_text())['version']=='1.60.0'
browsers=json.loads((modules/'playwright-core/browsers.json').read_text())['browsers']
assert any(value['name']=='chromium-headless-shell' and value['revision']=='1223' for value in browsers)
with socket.socket() as listener:
    listener.bind(('127.0.0.1',0))
    port=listener.getsockname()[1]
environment={'HOME':str(job/'profile'),'PATH':'/private/tmp/hol-guard-cigar-locked-runtime/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin',
             'LANG':'en_US.UTF-8','PYTHONNOUSERSITE':'1','PYTHONPATH':os.pathsep.join((str(INSTALLED),str(REPO))),
             'HOL_GUARD_TEST_USE_INSTALLED':'1','HOL_GUARD_NATIVE':'force','HOL_GUARD_NATIVE_BINARY':str(RUNTIME),
             'HOL_GUARD_NATIVE_REGRESSION':'1',
             'HOL_GUARD_TEST_DISABLE_BROWSER_OPEN':'1','GUARD_CIGAR_TEST_SELECTION':str(selection),
             'GUARD_CIGAR_TEST_APPROVAL':str(approval),'DASHBOARD_E2E_ROOT':str(job/'fixture'),
             'DASHBOARD_E2E_PORT':str(port),'DASHBOARD_E2E_PYTHON':sys.executable,
             'SCRG_PROOF_DIR':str(job/'proof'),'PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH':'/private/tmp/hol-guard-cigar-browser-cache'}
paths={ROOT/'browser-stop-diagnostic/context-assistance.mutating.spec.ts', ROOT/'browser-stop-diagnostic/package.json'}
paths.update((REPO/'tests').glob('context*.py'))
paths.update((REPO/'dashboard/e2e').rglob('*.ts'))
paths.update((REPO/'scripts/ci/dashboard_integration_seeds').rglob('*.py'))
paths.update([REPO/'scripts/ci/dashboard_integration_server.py',REPO/'scripts/ci/installed_extension_authority_fixture.py',
              REPO/'dashboard/playwright.integration.config.ts',REPO/'dashboard/package.json',REPO/'dashboard/package-lock.json',
              ROOT/'browser-stop-diagnostic/config.mts',ROOT/'functional-acceptance-plan.json',ROOT/'package/installed-artifact-verification.json',
              Path(__file__),node.resolve(),Path('/private/tmp/hol-guard-cigar-sdk-target/debug/cigar-context-worker')])
for package in ['@playwright/test','playwright','playwright-core']:
    paths.update(path for path in (modules/package).rglob('*') if path.is_file() and path.suffix in {'.js','.cjs','.mjs','.json'})
paths.update(Path('/private/tmp/hol-guard-cigar-browser-cache').rglob('chrome-headless-shell'))
assets=json.loads((ROOT/'static-staging.json').read_text())['verified_asset_sha256']
for name,value in assets.items():
    path=INSTALLED/Path(name).relative_to('src')
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==value
    paths.add(path)
frozen=fingerprints(RUNTIME,INSTALLED)
for path in paths:frozen[str(path)]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
with (job/'inputs.json').open('x') as out:json.dump(frozen,out,indent=2)
specs=['context-assistance.mutating.spec.ts']
command=[str(node),str(cli),'test','--config',str(ROOT/'browser-stop-diagnostic/config.mts'),'--project=mutating','--no-deps',
         '--max-failures=1',*specs]
started=time.monotonic()
with ProcessSampler(selected_python) as sampler:
    before,baseline=sampler.sample_with_identities()
    with (job/'stdout.log').open('x') as out,(job/'stderr.log').open('x') as err:
        result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=REPO/'dashboard',env=environment,stdout=out,stderr=err,timeout=600)

    while remaining.keys()-baseline.keys() and time.monotonic()<deadline:
        time.sleep(.05)
        after,remaining=sampler.sample_with_identities()
    new_descendants=len(remaining.keys()-baseline.keys())
    resources=sampler.summary()
report=json.loads((job/'report.json').read_text()) if (job/'report.json').exists() else {}
stats=report.get('stats',{})
receipt={'schema':'guard-cigar-worker-reuse-browser-controller.v1','command':command,'returncode':result.returncode,
         'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'source_commit':artifact['build_sha'],'planned_cases':1,'stats':stats,
         'inputs_unchanged':all(hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==value for path,value in frozen.items()),
         'fingerprinted_files':len(frozen),'observed_new_descendants_remaining':new_descendants,'resources':resources,
         'installed_static_assets':len(assets),'static_override':False,'traces_and_screenshots':'off',
         'fixture_only_password_and_session_proofs':True,'real_credentials_or_live_Guard_accessed':False,
         'scope':'Three existing React/HTTP/installed-native flows with explicit test-native selection; local Chromium headless shell1223/Playwright1.60.0; no Desktop release qualification'}
with (job/'controller.json').open('x') as out:json.dump(receipt,out,indent=2);out.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({key:receipt[key] for key in ['returncode','seconds','planned_cases','stats','inputs_unchanged','fingerprinted_files','observed_new_descendants_remaining']}))
if result.returncode:
    print((job/'stderr.log').read_text()[-4000:])
raise SystemExit(result.returncode or int(not receipt['inputs_unchanged']) or int(stats.get('expected')!=1)
                 or int(any(stats.get(name,1)!=0 for name in ['skipped','unexpected','flaky']))
                 or int(new_descendants!=0) or int(resources['sampling_errors']!=0))

interpretation: The first browser setup fails because its private runner supplies a compiler override alongside a packaged compiler. Removing only that runner override permits real product execution; native compiler protection stays intact.

The next original browser suite fails after Stop reports native off but reload shows an enabled draft. One case fails and two do not run; stable inputs and final containment are retained. That invocation has no request-order trace, so its exact cause remains unproven.

Native source revokes before cleanup and the settings write. Early read-only native status is not acknowledgement that persistence completed. A persistence test must await the Stop HTTP response before reloading.

The separately instrumented intended first case passes in 36.648 seconds with unchanged assertions and product bytes. A tool read observes Stop acknowledgement 21 ms before the early off observation, followed by settings enabled=false. This confirms acknowledged persistence in that diagnostic, not the original failed invocation timing.

The diagnostic overall fails because Playwright recursively discovers a retained archived spec and times it out after the intended case passes. The extra archive is outside the diagnostic driver fingerprint list and later overwrites the shared observation output. Only the printed first-case subset survives; the full array is not retained. The extra run and overall diagnostic are unqualified. No diagnostic is rerun after this outcome.

Two preceding diagnostic loader/helper-location failures are retained. Every terminal controller records zero remaining descendants. No product source, SDK, deadline, threshold or approval semantics change.

The original three browser cases now use a test-only helper to await the same Stop response and add status=200/requested=false/effective=false/runtime=null checks. All prior assertions remain. Fresh original-suite acceptance is required.
